description: Ministry of Investment Promotion - The Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act. No 11 of 2021 Details of the Business Designated as a Secondary Business of Strategic (HORIZON GROUP USA GLOBAL LLC)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily involves the specification of exemptions and incentives under the Colombo Port City Economic Commission Act, No. 11 of 2021. It constitutes a regulatory order that establishes legal frameworks for business operations, specifies eligibility criteria, and outlines the application of specific regulations. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
